evidence.title: Rent reminder
evidence.text: Payment due December 1. Jamie has written 'extra shift?' in the margin.

evidence.title: Photo on desk
evidence.text: Kay and Jamie on a windy afternoon. The date on the back is June 2006.

evidence.title: Bypass sign
evidence.text: Through traffic: use the new bypass.

evidence.title: Local radio
evidence.text: Light rain overnight. The old Route 9 remains open to local traffic.

evidence.title: Opening photograph
evidence.text: Marlow's Market, May 16, 1987. Arthur is standing beside a ribbon.

evidence.title: Employee schedule
evidence.text: Jamie Walker: hired November 10. A blank space remains on the older schedule.

evidence.title: Staff photograph
evidence.text: Evan wears a green shirt and holds a crooked paper crown from his birthday.

evidence.title: Mara's recollection
evidence.text: Evan always remembered which tea I bought. He never made me ask twice.

evidence.title: Ben's recollection
evidence.text: He made decent coffee. Last time I saw him he said he was staying late for a meeting.

evidence.title: Local newspaper
evidence.text: New bypass redirects through traffic away from old Route 9, 2003.

evidence.title: Delivery discrepancy
evidence.text: Invoice quantity differs from the office copy. Gus has circled the correction.

evidence.title: Locker note
evidence.text: Training binder. Back sleeve. Don't leave the only copy in the office.

evidence.title: Owner circular
evidence.text: August 20. Evan Miller is no longer employed here. Direct inquiries to management.

evidence.title: Termination notice
evidence.text: Leon Harker. Employment ended August 23. Reason: misconduct.

evidence.title: Missing-person notice
evidence.text: September 2. Evan Miller, 23. Family asks anyone with information to contact authorities.

evidence.title: Evan's notebook
evidence.text: August 12: third discrepancy. August 15: Dina says not to confront him alone. August 18: made copies.

evidence.title: Ledger copy
evidence.text: The same deposit appears with different totals on two signed sheets.

evidence.title: Training binder
evidence.text: A duplicate set of adjusted summaries, folded behind the training checklist.

evidence.title: Key log
evidence.text: August 23. Leon: return pending. Dina has added a question mark.

evidence.title: Archived camera excerpt
evidence.text: August 19. After midnight, Evan returns to the market. Arthur's account says he had already gone home.

evidence.title: Dina's message
evidence.text: I saw Evan come back. I didn't see what happened after that. I should have told someone sooner.

evidence.title: Owner message
evidence.text: Do not give out employee records. I will handle questions about August.

evidence.title: Maintenance log
evidence.text: Rear sensor tested. Service call not completed.

evidence.title: Wet marks
evidence.text: Fresh water on the staff corridor floor. Someone has been through recently.
